mapper.select: SELECT id, community_code AS communityCd, community_name AS communityName, community_place AS communityPlace, community_area AS communityArea, people_number AS peopleNumber FROM communities WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE communities SET del_flag = 1, updateTime = current_time WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE communities SET community_area = #{communityArea}, people_number = #{peopleNumber}, updateTime = current_time WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE communities SET state = #{state}, updateTime = current_time WHERE id = #{id}
